categories.label: Lexicon
categories.description: Separate each meaning and preserve spelling, morphology and real examples.

fields.label: Part of speech
fields.hint: For example noun, verb, particle; write unknown if unresolved.

fields.label: Definition in Kasem
fields.hint: Explain this meaning in Kasem.

fields.label: Meaning and sense
fields.hint: Specify this meaning and distinguish other senses.

fields.label: IPA and tone
fields.hint: Record a verified transcription; leave unknown analysis explicit.

fields.label: Word forms and structure
fields.hint: Record noun class, plural, conjugation, or morphemes where known.

fields.label: Attested example
fields.hint: A real Kasem example with its English meaning and situation.

fields.label: Usage limits
fields.hint: Register, restrictions, collocations and uncommon uses.

fields.label: Origin and related words
fields.hint: Distinguish documented origins from hypotheses.

fields.label: Gender or noun class
fields.hint: Record only what the source supports. Leave unresolved analysis explicit.

fields.label: Usage type: traditional, everyday, formal or archaic

categories.label: Grammar
categories.description: Describe scoped rules supported by examples and counterexamples.

fields.label: Rule or claim
fields.hint: State the proposed pattern without treating a hypothesis as a fact.

fields.label: Scope and exceptions
fields.hint: Where, when and in which dialect this pattern applies.

fields.label: Linguistic structure
fields.hint: Word order, clause roles and morpheme analysis. Mark unresolved analysis.

fields.label: Supporting examples
fields.hint: Kasem examples, meanings and contextual differences.

fields.label: Counterexamples
fields.hint: Contexts where the claim fails or another form is preferred.

fields.label: Evidence references
fields.hint: Link reviewed sentence IDs or exact source locations.

fields.label: Grammar category

fields.label: Intended meaning
fields.hint: What a speaker communicates.

fields.label: Who says it to whom
fields.hint: Relationships, age, social setting and register.

fields.label: Natural response
fields.hint: Typical reply, when one is expected.

fields.label: Alternatives and limits
fields.hint: Other forms and situations where this expression is unsuitable.

fields.label: Register

categories.label: Sentences
categories.description: Keep full meaning, context and linguistic structure together.

fields.label: Sentence type
fields.hint: Statement, question, command, negative or another construction.

fields.label: Literal reading
fields.hint: A literal paraphrase; never force uncertain particles into English words.

fields.label: Word or phrase analysis
fields.hint: Align known words/phrases, roles and morphemes; label unknown spans.

fields.label: Construction
fields.hint: For example focus, possession, negation or tense.

fields.label: Preceding conversation
fields.hint: What came immediately before this sentence.

fields.label: Acceptable alternatives
fields.hint: Alternative wordings with any difference in meaning.

categories.label: Proverbs
categories.description: Preserve the words, interpretation and cultural authority behind a saying.

fields.label: Literal translation
fields.hint: The image or literal wording used in the proverb.

fields.label: Interpretation
fields.hint: The lesson, figurative meaning and alternative interpretations.

fields.label: When and by whom it is used
fields.hint: A real use case, speaker/audience and restrictions.

fields.label: Cultural source
fields.hint: Elder, storyteller or documented source; use a consented name or reference.

fields.label: English equivalent, if any
fields.hint: Record a verified equivalent, no direct equivalent, or unknown.

fields.label: French equivalent, if any
fields.hint: Record a verified equivalent, no direct equivalent, or unknown.

fields.label: Misuse and cautions
